name: Tsumabeni
source:
Don’t think to hard."

"Women are the prettiest when they smile."

The guardian of the Chrysanthemum Kamon, and the Butterfly under Ghislain.
Doesn’t care much about small things, rather he is the type to care about the big picture.

In an urgent situation his decisions are wise, and he is generally a quick decision maker

[from [url=http://cannonette.tumblr.com/post/90743940677/reine-des-fleurs-side-characters]cannonette[/url]]
